steps.text: A review of the earlier “side” trials shows their jaw closing axis had rotated nearly vertical, so they could not pinch the rim horizontally. I’m switching to a side approach with the fingers closing along world y and the approach axis along world x, then I’ll move just inside the lid’s left edge.

steps.text: The large lid is now suspended and stayed with the gripper through a higher lift. I’m carrying it over the pot using the camera calibration and the observed offset between the gripper and the lid center; I’ll check the overlap before releasing.
